Part 1 高频 地点 PLACE

Parks

公园

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Did you like going to parks as a child?

Oh yeah, definitely. I loved going to parks when I was little, you know, running around and playing with friends on the swings. We'd go almost every weekend, and I always looked forward to it.

小时候很喜欢去公园，和小伙伴荡秋千、奔跑，几乎每周都去，特别期待。

Q2Do you still like going to parks now?

Yeah, I do, actually. I still go now, especially to Shenzhen Bay Park. It's right by the sea, so the view is amazing, and it's perfect for relaxing after a long week.

现在还爱去，最喜欢深圳湾公园，靠海景色美，很适合放松。

Q3Would you like to see more parks in your city?

Absolutely, I would. I mean, Shenzhen is quite crowded, so more green spaces would give people somewhere quiet to unwind. Plus, parks make a city feel much more liveable, honestly.

希望多建公园，深圳太拥挤，需要更多绿地让人放松，城市也更宜居。

Q4Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?

Yeah, quite a few, actually. I'd love to explore more parks along the coast, like the ones near Shenzhen Bay, because I love the sea breeze. Honestly, I'd rather spend a day in a park than in a mall.

想探索更多沿海公园，比如深圳湾一带，相比商场更愿意待在公园。
